# Local font sources

These are the same Google Fonts families and Latin subsets previously used by
the page. They are unmodified variable WOFF2 files, served locally to avoid an
external render-blocking Google Fonts stylesheet.

- Cormorant Garamond normal, weights 400–500:
  https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/cormorantgaramond/v21/co3bmX5slCNuHLi8bLeY9MK7whWMhyjYqXtK.woff2
- Cormorant Garamond italic, weights 400–500:
  https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/cormorantgaramond/v21/co3ZmX5slCNuHLi8bLeY9MK7whWMhyjYrEtImSo.woff2
- Manrope normal, weights 400–700:
  https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/manrope/v20/xn7gYHE41ni1AdIRggexSg.woff2

Retrieved from the Google Fonts CSS API on 2026-10-09. Each family's SIL Open
Font License is included next to the files as `CormorantGaramond-OFL.txt` and
`Manrope-OFL.txt`. License sources:

- https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/cormorantgaramond/OFL.txt
- https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/manrope/OFL.txt
